label: Search economy code retrieval Q1 enriched single shot and Q2 agentic DAG arm results evidence chunk 2
title: Search economy code retrieval Q1 enriched single shot and Q2 agentic DAG arm results evidence chunk 2
summary:
Q1 ENRICHED SINGLE-SHOT (LOCATE = one GET /search?k=8 code tier) — CONFIRMED the fix on the real shipped path. Measured as a clean Q1-only A/B (enriched vs thin embed, identical fetch+metric, separate isolated workspaces on one daemon):
  ENRICHED: mean body-recall 0.705, hits 10/13, ~1153 tok, ~442 tok/correct
  THIN    : mean body-recall 0.385, hits  6/13, ~1158 tok, ~658 tok/correct
  LIFT: 0.385 -> 0.705 (+0.321). The thin number reproduces the shipped-thin 0.385 reference EXACTLY; enriched (0.705) exceeds the prior enriched-DIAGNOSTIC 0.647. Body-fold flips q02/q04/q07/q08/q10/q13 from miss to hit; q11 regressed (thin 1.0 -> enr 0.0, body fold pulled a distractor). NOTE: an earlier combined run that INTERLEAVED Q1 and Q2 per-query reported a contaminated 0.462 — the Q2 agentic calls mutated recall-journal/telemetry state that perturbed subsequent Q1 /search rankings; the clean Q1-only A/B (0.705) is the trustworthy number. A ranking probe confirmed enriched /search ranks ground-truth symbols at/near top (q02 gateTask #1 cos0.428; q12 judgingState #3, buildQueue #11; q03 askGate #11 borderline).
